verdict.rationale: Hightouch's core sync engine operates on whole audiences/models (bulk data movement) and exposes a batch event endpoint and REST API for managing many syncs/models/destinations programmatically, and the MCP server lets an AI assistant create audiences and manage syncs in natural language. However, the MCP examples shown are single-audience/single-sync actions, not explicit multi-item bulk operations orchestrated by an AI agent. Missing for 10: documented example of an AI-native workflow performing bulk actions across multiple audiences/syncs/objects in one request, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale AI operations.
